scan.scope: contracts/ (market, vault, vault_factory, referral, risk, noeracle_shim, noether_router, noether_common; 23 files)
scan.capture: Manual UI copy (free tier; JSON export paywalled). Full text in findings.md; ALX-17 description not captured, verified from code.
scan.triage: Verified against code by Claude 2026-08-18; grouped actions in audit/remediation/REGISTER.md

verdict_key.procedural: real; mitigated by runbook/config rather than code
verdict_key.false-positive: stated exploit does not hold; residual noted
verdict_key.accepted: true observation, risk accepted with rationale
verdict_key.duplicate: same root cause as an earlier finding

findings.title: Unbounded VaultList Vec can brick contract
findings.summary: Single persistent Vec<u32> of all vault ids grows on every create_vault; with allowlist empty and max_vaults 0 an attacker can grow it past the ~64KiB object cap, bricking creation and enumeration. L0-20 launch gate (set_leader_allowlist / set_max_vaults) already exists and is tested — close via launch config; paging deferred.

findings.title: Instance TTL expiry enables contract reinitialization takeover
findings.summary: Claimed re-initialize-as-attacker after instance archival. Archived instance entries fail every invocation until restored; restore returns Initialized=true with the original admin. No takeover; residual is availability (restore + TTL hygiene).

findings.title: SEP-40 TWAP reports 'now' masking staleness
findings.summary: SEP-40 twap branch fabricates freshness with env.ledger().timestamp(), defeating the market's twap_max_age_secs gate during backend staleness. Latent: deployed mode is Noeracle-native (0). Fix pre-freeze: propagate backend timestamp or return None.

findings.title: Persistent state can expire, locking funds
findings.summary: Claimed permanent loss when vault rows/shares expire. Archived persistent entries are restorable with original values (RestoreFootprintOp; RPC returns restorePreamble). Residual: idle vaults need a restore before use — TTL sweep + keeper re-pin + runbook.

findings.title: Instance TTL not refreshed, contract can brick
findings.summary: Referral extends instance TTL only in initialize/create_code; hot paths never extend, so the instance can archive despite active use (halting discounts/claims until restore — funds survive). Note ~1-day threshold means only calls in the final day re-extend. In the R-1 sweep.

findings.title: Anyone can seize admin via initialize
findings.summary: Deploy-then-init race: initialize accepts an arbitrary admin. Same pattern in all crates. Low practical risk on Stellar (no public mempool) but real; ceremony must deploy+init back-to-back and verify get_admin == multisig before funding. Constructor init needs SDK>=22, deferred.

findings.title: Loss accounting can be inflated without transfer
findings.summary: receive_loss credits total_usdc without verifying receipt; caller is the trusted market (require_auth). Accepted as designed; cheap solvency assert (accounting <= physical balance) scheduled pre-freeze as defense-in-depth, also covering fund_buffer/route_protocol_fee.

findings.title: NOE supply tracking can desync from token
findings.summary: Share pricing trusts internal total_noe_circulating; the classic-asset issuer could mint/burn outside the vault. Fix at mainnet ceremony: pre-mint full supply to vault then lock the issuer (master weight 0) making supply provably immutable, or keep issuer under the 2-of-3 multisig; decision box.

findings.title: Unbounded vault list can brick contract
findings.summary: Duplicate of ALX-01 stated from create_vault's side.

findings.title: Instance storage TTL not maintained causing shutdown
findings.summary: Shim extends instance TTL only at initialize; archived shim halts all price reads (and trading) until restore. Highest-impact TTL family member; extend on lastprice/twap + keeper re-pin.

findings.title: Unbounded global vault list can DoS creation
findings.summary: Duplicate of ALX-01 stated from append_vault_list.

findings.title: Instance storage TTL extended only at init
findings.summary: Router never extends instance TTL after initialize; archival halts the verify-then-trade path until restore. (Finding's griefing claim is wrong — failed txs cannot block extensions; inactivity is the only trigger.) In the R-1 sweep.

findings.title: Deposit cap resets after TTL expiration
findings.summary: Archived Deposited(addr) entries fail the deposit until restored with the original cumulative value; waiting cannot reset the cap.

findings.title: Shortfall claims can be lost to TTL
findings.summary: Archived ShortfallOwed entries are restorable with original values; claims are not erased and the shortfall invariant survives. Residual: restore needed after long idleness — runbook + keeper re-pin.

findings.title: Unchecked math can wrap and corrupt accounting
findings.summary: Premise false: contracts/Cargo.toml sets overflow-checks = true in release (contradicted by ALX-20 from the same scan) — overflow traps and reverts, never wraps. Residual trap-DoS angle is ALX-20; optional checked_* cleanup for audit optics.

findings.title: LP actions lack slippage bounds on outputs
findings.summary: deposit/withdraw need min_noe_out/min_usdc_out so LPs get bounded outcomes as AUM/PnL move between signing and inclusion. Pre-freeze (ABI change; ripples into tx-builders, web, SDKs).

findings.title: Order/position ID counters can overflow silently
findings.summary: u64 monotonic id counters need ~1.8e19 increments to exhaust; unreachable, and overflow-checks would trap rather than wrap. (Description not captured from UI; verified from code.)

findings.title: Storage TTL not maintained on reads
findings.summary: Risk contract bumps instance TTL only at initialize and never extends persistent Config(asset) on reads; archived config halts dependent markets (fail-closed) until restore. In the R-1 sweep.

findings.title: Unvalidated negative trade size corrupts volume tiers
findings.summary: No public path yields non-positive size: min_collateral > 0 and leverage bounds are enforced at every entry (open, cross, orders), so size = collateral x leverage > 0. Optional one-line size > 0 guard as boundary hardening.

findings.title: Overflow traps can DoS fee/volume updates
findings.summary: Correct premise (traps revert); unreachable in practice — caps keep intermediates around 1e20 vs i128's 1.7e38. Revisit only if caps rise by many orders of magnitude.

findings.title: Withdraw cooldown can be bypassed via TTL
findings.summary: Archived LastDepositTs fails the withdraw until restored with the original timestamp; cooldown (seconds-days) is far shorter than the ~30d TTL window; 0-exempt branch is deliberate for pre-upgrade depositors.

findings.title: Position value addition can overflow silently
findings.summary: Same false 'silent wrap' premise as ALX-15; overflow-checks = true traps, magnitudes bounded by position caps. Covered by optional checked_* cleanup.

findings.title: Persistent per-user keys can grow unbounded
findings.summary: Per-address entries never pruned; attacker pays fees and rent, entries archive when unpaid — self-limiting. Optional: delete ShortfallOwed entries at 0.

findings.title: Day-0 sentinel can mis-handle real day 0
findings.summary: last_update_day == 0 uninitialized sentinel only misbehaves with near-epoch timestamps; impossible on real networks. Test-environment quirk; no action.
